environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with full internet access. The instance has an IAM role with no restrictions. The application runs with AllowUnsafeBlocks enabled and has full P/Invoke capabilities. No memory sanitizers or heap hardening enabled. The container runs as root with default seccomp profile.

config.network: public subnet with IGW route, security group allows all outbound
